We believe that with great education, every neurodivergent pupil can thrive and make their way in the world.
Welcome to Brick Lane School
Our vision is to provide a safe and welcoming environment where education and learning are highly valued. At Brick Lane School, diversity is embraced and young people are encouraged to take control of their progress and prospects, with the support of a highly skilled and nurturing team around them.
Latest
Clinical
When children are happy, confident and well equipped to manage the day-to-day challenges of life, they thrive academically
Education
We offer opportunities for our pupils to achieve qualifications across a range of academic and vocational subjects
© OFG Education 2026

Home Important Information
Please see below for important information, our school uniform, term dates, and other key information.
You will see the link below for Parent Portal, we advise all parent/carers who can access this to follow the link and sign up. This is a great platform to access information such as your child’s school contacts, medical information, holiday request forms and more. If you need support setting this up, please ask for help at the school office.
Tune in to Autism Unpacked, where we’re navigating SEN together through honest conversations, expert insight, lived experience and practical advice.
We’re joined by professionals from education and therapy, alongside parents, carers and people with lived experience, to share practical insights, explore the topics that matter and help families and those supporting children and young people feel better informed.
© OFG Education 2026

Home News & Events Careers Fair – Wednesday 2nd July 2025!
Careers Fair – Wednesday 2nd July 2025!
On Wednesday 2nd July, Brick Lane School will be hosting a careers fair for all pupils, parents and carers. This is to host workers from different industries from sports, hospitality to education and more! Please contact the school for further information, should you wish to know more about our upcoming careers day.
Please have a look at the lovely things we have been doing at Brick Lane!
© OFG Education 2026

© OFG Education 2026

Home Referrals and admissions
Referrals and Admissions
We’re more than happy to take referrals directly from parents and carers, and with a network of schools and homes across the UK, we’re able to identify the right setting for each individual child or young person.
Parents and Carers are advised to talk first with the SENDCo at their child’s current place of education. The SENDCo (along with the parent/carer) can then refer to the Local Authority admission placement process where decisions for referral will be made.
For admission children and young people:
If you’d like to make a referral or you simply want to know more, please don’t hesitate to get in touch.

Home Our Approach Safeguarding
Safeguarding
We are committed to providing the highest standards in relation to the safeguarding of the children and young people entrusted to our care.
We support all students by:
We expect all staff and visitors to our school to behave in a way which ensures our children are safeguarded at all times. This includes a duty for any safeguarding concerns to be reported to the Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL) or Deputy Designated Safeguarding Lead (DDSL).
You can contact our Safeguarding team directly via emailing Safeguarding@bricklaneschool.co.uk

Curriculum
Our curriculum underpins our ethos and aims to ensure that students with autism are given the opportunity to achieve high standards within a supportive community.
We work closely with our clinical team, parents and carers, staff and students to ensure we help students develop social understanding, improve their wellbeing and become as independent as possible.
